---
name: Bug report
about: Report an observable failure in rules, skills or tooling.
labels: bug
---

## Expected and observed behaviour

Describe the concrete task, expected decision/result and what actually happened.

## Reproduce and verify

Include the rules revision, agent/runtime and minimal safe reproduction. Link
relevant evidence; omit credentials, prompts and private project content.

## Acceptance

What observable result would demonstrate that this is fixed? Identify any
preservation, compatibility or performance boundary the fix must retain.
